meta.title: Development Workstation
meta.description: Chat-first development flows for DeepSeek Harness: scan a repository, clarify the requirement, plan the change, isolate worktrees, run independent review, verify tests and generate a scope-aware report.

messages.开发流程台账 · 会话状态 · 并行开发 · 独立评审 · 测试与提交: Flow ledger · session state · parallel work · review & delivery
messages.新建开发流程 · 说一句要做什么 · 工作站扫仓库、追问、自评计划: New flow · describe intent · scan, clarify, plan
messages.用一段话描述你要做什么：工作站会扫仓库、追问、自评计划，再确认范围。: Describe what you want to do: the workstation scans, clarifies, estimates and asks you to confirm the scope.
messages.还有审核员在返回中：等本轮结束或重置后再重试: Reviewers are still returning; wait for this round to finish or reset before retrying
messages.选中的目标决定下方「开发流程」: The selected target drives the flow list below
messages.有进展，但没有绑定开发会话: Progress exists, but no session is bound
messages.先确认文件/范围与追问，再让工作站生成计划。: Confirm files/scope and questions before generating a plan.
messages.计划已生成：确认后按计划开工，或点「再调整范围」改完重算。: Plan ready: confirm to start, or adjust scope and regenerate.
messages.Enter 发送 · Shift+Enter 换行: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
messages.用一句话补充或纠偏，例如：验收再加一条失败可回滚；顺便把「跑门禁」标成已完成: Add a sentence to clarify, e.g. add rollback to acceptance and mark the gate as done
messages.直接说就行：工作站会判断这句话是补台账、发开发会话，还是两者都做。: Just say it: the workstation decides whether to update the ledger, the session, or both.
messages.澄清不会直接改代码；确认计划后才创建流程并开启开发会话。: Clarification does not change code; the flow is created only after you approve the plan.
messages.切到其他页面再回来，进度和扫描结果会从本机对话记录恢复。: Switch pages and come back; progress and scan results are restored from the local chat log.
messages.这一轮已经提交，可以继续补充，或直接生成计划。: This round is submitted. Ask another round or generate the plan.
messages.命中里没有测试文件。这次要不要一起补单测？: No test files in the matches. Add unit tests in this flow?
messages.先不补，后面单独做: Skip for now; do it separately
messages.澄清降级为本地规则: Clarification fell back to local rules
messages.需求通常很粗：先用 dsh 走一轮澄清（后续可多轮），问准“到底解决什么问题”: Requirements are usually rough: clarify first, then plan.
messages.结果可能不全：扫描达到上限，可把要做什么写得更具体。: Results may be incomplete: the scan hit its limit. Try describing what you want more specifically.
messages.可能改动的文件（勾选进入开发上下文；默认全选）: Files that may change (check to include in the dev context; all selected by default)
messages.当时确认的候选文件: Candidate files confirmed at the time
messages.没有命中候选文件。可以直接按目录/模块建流程，或点「重新描述」补充关键词。: No candidate files matched. You can create a flow by directory/module directly, or click 「Describe again」 to add keywords.
messages.开发范围 scope（用于并行冲突判定；裸路径 = 目录，module:xxx: Dev scope (used for parallel conflict checks; bare path = directory, module:xxx = module name)
messages.Host 没给出建议范围，请手填一个目录或 module:名称。: The host didn't suggest a scope. Enter a directory or module:name manually.
messages.尚未选择任何范围；至少要保留一个目录或模块才能创建流程。: No scope selected yet; keep at least one directory or module to create a flow.
messages.先在下方回答工作站的问题（可以跳过），再点「继续，生成计划」。: Answer the workstation's questions below first (you can skip), then click 「Continue, generate plan」.
messages.当时没有确认开发范围。: No dev scope was confirmed at the time.
messages.agent 会顺带给一个标题，可改: The agent will also suggest a title; you can edit it
messages.已经能写出问题定义：点「生成计划」继续（或再问一轮补细节）。: The problem definition is ready: click 「Generate plan」 to continue (or ask another round for details).
messages.问题会一轮轮收敛；也可以直接点「生成计划」，我会按当前信息开工。: Questions converge round by round; you can also click 「Generate plan」 directly and I'll start with the current information.
messages.工作站想确认几件事: The workstation wants to confirm a few things
messages.可以跳过，我按默认做法推进；答了会影响计划里的步骤、范围与验收。: You can skip; I'll proceed with defaults. Answering will shape the plan's steps, scope and acceptance criteria.
messages.点击选择（再点一次取消）: Click to select (click again to deselect)
messages.写下你的回答，Enter 提交（留空 = 跳过）: Write your answer, Enter to submit (leave blank = skip)
messages.当时没有回答，按默认做法推进: No answer at the time; proceeded with defaults
messages.工作站没有返回计划步骤，建议补充描述后重新生成。: The workstation returned no plan steps. Try adding details and generating again.
messages.工作站暂时没有识别到特别风险。: The workstation hasn't identified any notable risks.
messages.工作站没有返回验收标准。: The workstation returned no acceptance criteria.
messages.开工前拉取最新代码（git fetch + merge --ff-only）: Pull the latest code before starting (git fetch + merge --ff-only)
messages.请先在“流程”页完成代码库初始化: Finish repository initialization on the “Flows” page first
messages.工作站需要一个代码库路径才能扫仓库、建流程和开启开发会话。: The workstation needs a repository path to scan the repo, create flows and start dev sessions.
messages.去“流程”页初始化: Go to the “Flows” page to initialize
messages.说说你要做什么: Tell me what you want to do
messages.我会自己扫一遍仓库，列出可能要改的文件与命中行；不懂的地方会问你几个问题（可以跳: I'll scan the repo myself and list the files that may change with the matching lines; where I'm unsure I'll ask a few questions (you can skip them).
messages.1. 扫描仓库，给出候选文件与命中行；2. 不懂的地方向你追问；3. 自己出计划: 1. Scan the repo and list candidate files with matching lines; 2. Ask you about anything unclear; 3. Draft a plan myself (size/person-days/steps/acceptance, with rationale); 4. Once you confirm, create the flow and start the dev session.
messages.例如：把关卡状态回传从同步改成异步，解决连接池被远端 IO 占满的问题。: e.g. Change the checkpoint status callback from sync to async to stop remote IO from exhausting the connection pool.
messages.还没有候选文件：先发一句需求，或点「重新扫描」: No candidate files yet: send a requirement first, or click 「Rescan」
messages.发送后工作站会把路径交给 dsh：图片用 read_image 读取；模型不支持: After sending, the workstation passes the paths to dsh: images are read with read_image; if the model doesn't support images you'll be told clearly.
messages.澄清进行中…（完成后会直接出下一轮问题或规格）: Clarifying… (on completion you'll get the next round of questions or the spec directly)
messages.请先确认上面的文件/范围与追问，再点「继续，生成计划」: Confirm the files/scope and questions above first, then click 「Continue, generate plan」
messages.计划已生成：请确认开工，或点「再调整范围」: Plan generated: confirm to start, or click 「Adjust scope again」
messages.说一句你要做什么（Enter 发送，Shift+Enter 换行）: Say what you want to do (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
messages.粘贴截图，或选择日志/代码文件作为需求输入: Paste a screenshot, or choose a log/code file as requirement input
messages.当前模型不支持图片；可引用日志/代码文件: The current model doesn't support images; you can reference log/code files
messages.开发工作站渲染出错: Failed to render the dev workstation
messages.界面没有白屏，但这一段没法渲染。请刷新页面重试；如果反复出现，把上面的错误信息发: The page isn't blank, but this section failed to render. Refresh the page and try again; if it keeps happening, send the error above to the maintainer (the console has the full stack).
messages.单个代码库，或前后端多库组合: A single repo, or a front-end/back-end multi-repo set
messages.从列表移除这个代码库（不动磁盘文件）: Remove this repository from the list (files on disk are untouched)
messages.编辑这个虚拟库：改名、增删成员库（成员库平权，任意成员都可移除/替换）: Edit this virtual repo: rename it, add or remove member repos (members are peers; any member can be removed or replaced)
messages.从本机移除这个虚拟库（不动成员库代码与流程台账）: Remove this virtual repo from this machine (member repo code and flow ledgers are untouched)
messages.只读分析：结论产出即结束，不进入提交: Read-only analysis: ends once the conclusion is produced, no submit stage
messages.标题像原始输入或代码片段，进详情可自动生成: The title looks like raw input or a code snippet; open details to generate it automatically
messages.在新标签打开开发报告（目标背景 / 改动范围 / 测试报告）: Open the dev report in a new tab (goals & context / change scope / test report)
messages.建议改为串行：冲突范围内的改动互相影响，串行执行更安全。: Switch to serial: changes in overlapping scopes affect each other, so serial execution is safer.
messages.填一个已有代码库的路径（或选择目录）；它会加入代码库卡片，环境自动探测一次后缓存: Enter the path of an existing repository (or pick a directory); it's added as a repository card, and the environment is probed once and cached.
messages.只需要填代码库路径和你的名字；系统、Shell、JDK、Maven、Git 和可: Just fill in the repository path and your name; OS, shell, JDK, Maven, Git and available tools are detected automatically.
messages.尚未探测本机环境。: The local environment hasn't been probed yet.
messages.分两层：项目命令提交到仓库、团队共用；本机命令只存在这台电脑（~/.dsh/de: Two layers: project commands are committed to the repo and shared with the team; local commands live only on this machine (~/.dsh/dev-hub/profile.json), aren't committed and don't affect anyone else.
messages.本机命令（只在这台电脑生效，不提交）: Local commands (this machine only, not committed)
messages.留空＝沿用项目命令；填了就在这台电脑上覆盖对应按钮的执行命令。: Leave blank = use project commands; if filled, it overrides that button's command on this machine.
messages.留空则用项目命令；也可以在这里写本机专用命令: Leave blank to use project commands; or write a machine-specific command here
messages.用一句话生成本机命令: Generate a local command from one sentence
messages.描述你本机实际怎么跑（例如：本机用 kpipe-dev 把服务部署到本机环境，再: Describe how it actually runs on your machine (e.g. kpipe-dev deploys the service to the local environment, then curl a health check). dsh checks repo scripts and installed tools first, turns it into one command for you to confirm, and never runs it automatically.
messages.台账/规范/上下文/证据写在本机独立目录，不写任何成员库: Ledger/conventions/context/evidence live in a separate local directory, never in any member repo
messages.已把客户原话整理成目标/根因: Turned the customer's exact words into goals/root cause
messages.没生成比原话更合适的标题：可以直接手动改一个: No better title than the original wording was generated: you can edit one manually
messages.（工作站不可用，按目标兜底生成）: (Workstation unavailable; generated as a fallback from the goal)
messages.开发会话正在工作，等当前这步结束再继续推进: The dev session is busy; wait for the current step to finish before continuing
messages.已跳过（不需要在这个库跑）: Skipped (no need to run in this repo)
messages.拉取最新代码？\n\n会对当前流程涉及的仓库执行 git fetch + mer:
Pull the latest code?

This runs git fetch + merge --ff-only on the repositories in this flow. It never force-pushes or resets when there are local changes or diverged branches; failures are shown on the page.
messages.独立评审进行中：等审核员返回结论，不重复派发: Independent review in progress: waiting for reviewers to return a verdict, no duplicate dispatch
messages.请选择要提交的文件: Please select the files to commit
messages.请填写新分支名: Please enter a new branch name
messages.上次提交没推送成功：现在重试 git push？: The last commit was not pushed successfully: retry git push now?
messages.已取消知晓，重新计入待处理风险: Acknowledgement removed; counted again as pending risk
messages.目标现在还是客户原话，没经过规范化：先整理成「做什么 + 为什么」，再开发更稳。: The goal is still the customer's original wording and has not been normalized: turn it into "what + why" first, then development is steadier.
messages.工作站不可用，只能给本地草稿: Workstation unavailable; only a local draft is possible
messages.保存原样，不会拿它直接当目标；改目标/根因也不会改这里。: Saved as-is; it is never used directly as the goal, and editing the goal/root cause will not change it.
messages.随需求提供；开发会话按路径用 read_image / read 读取（图片要求: Provided with the request; the dev session reads them by path with read_image / read (images require a model with image input).
messages.明确这次不做什么: State explicitly what this change will not do
messages.scope 同时用于并行冲突判定: scope is also used to detect parallel conflicts
messages.关键文件/范围（一行一个；module:xxx 表示模块）: Key files/scopes (one per line; module:xxx means a module)
messages.禁止直接写解决方案: Do not write the solution directly
messages.还没整理成根因: Not yet narrowed down to a root cause
messages.下面是客户原话，不是根因：补上「现状是什么、为什么会这样」，再改代码。: Below is the customer's original wording, not a root cause: add "what the current situation is and why it happens", then change the code.
messages.根本问题 / 根因（必填，禁止直接写解决方案）: Core problem / root cause (required; do not write the solution directly)
messages.问题（例如：这次只改 source 还是全部改？）: Question (e.g.: should this change only source, or everything?)
messages.一行一个；勾选＝同意并知晓，未勾选计入「待处理风险」: One per line; checked = agreed and acknowledged, unchecked counts as "pending risk"
messages.已勾选「已知晓」的行如果被删除，对应勾选会自动清掉，不会留下孤儿状态。: If an acknowledged row is deleted, its acknowledgement is cleared automatically, leaving no orphaned state.
messages.已同意并知晓；取消勾选会重新计入待处理风险: Agreed and acknowledged; unchecking counts it as pending risk again
messages.勾选表示你已同意并知晓该风险: Checking means you agree to and acknowledge this risk
messages.语义变更点，一行一个: Semantic change points, one per line
messages.已按当前输入重算计划并记录指纹: Plan recalculated from current inputs and fingerprint recorded
messages.按需求类型带出的必改触点；不是建议，是清单: Required touchpoints derived from the request type; not suggestions but a checklist
messages.提交前每条都要有结果（命令逐条运行，断言人工确认）: Every item needs a result before commit (run commands one by one, confirm assertions manually)
messages.这个流程没有模板验收项（旧流程可「重算并记录」生成）: This flow has no template acceptance items (older flows can generate them with "Recalculate and record")
messages.照这些类/文档的结构写，别自创分层: Follow the structure of these classes/docs; don't invent your own layering
messages.工作站按仓库探测自评；这里只做确认或微调: Self-assessed by the workstation from repo probing; confirm or fine-tune here
messages.计划步骤（工作站已生成，一行一个）: Plan steps (generated by workstation, one per line)
messages.工作站还没有生成计划摘要: The workstation has not generated a plan summary yet
messages.工作站按探测结果估算，不需要你填写: Estimated by the workstation from probe results; no need for you to fill it in
messages.还没有更多依据：先补全探测结果与改动范围。: No further basis yet: complete the probe results and change scope first.
messages.勾选只代表开发任务完成；流程是否结束还要看测试与提交: Checking only means the dev task is done; whether the flow ends still depends on testing and commit
messages.开发任务与流程都已完成: Dev tasks and flow are both complete
messages.任务（一行一个；前缀 [x] 表示完成）: Tasks (one per line; prefix [x] means done)
messages.还没有任务；「批量编辑」可以一次粘贴: No tasks yet; "Bulk edit" lets you paste them all at once
messages.有就填链接；没有可让 lark-cli 创建: Add a link if you have one; otherwise lark-cli can create it
messages.待创建文档标题: Title of the doc to create
messages.这些文件没有可展开的文本 diff（二进制或纯重命名）；点左侧文件查看: These files have no expandable text diff (binary or rename-only); click a file on the left to view
messages.scope 内没有改动；取消勾选可看全部: No changes in scope; uncheck to see all
messages.这个流程还没有文件改动: This flow has no file changes yet
messages.查看这个文件的完整 diff: View the full diff for this file
messages.证据不完整：只显示工作区改动: Incomplete evidence: showing only workspace changes
messages.统计口径：baseline 以来的提交 + 当前工作区；默认只显示 scope: Counting basis: commits since baseline + current workspace; by default only in-scope items are shown, uncheck to see all. scope is the boundary confirmed when work started and does not expand automatically with changes; if an out-of-scope file belongs to this request, click "Add to scope".
messages.不在开工确认的 scope 内：scope 只按确认时的目录/模块判定；如属于本: Not within the scope confirmed at kickoff: scope is judged only by the directories/modules confirmed at that time; if it belongs to this request, click "Add to scope" on the right
messages.正在由 agent 补充说明…: The agent is adding a note…
messages.人工纠偏（默认由 agent 自动补充）: Manual correction (added automatically by the agent by default)
messages.一句话说明这个文件改了什么、为什么改: One sentence on what changed in this file and why
messages.右侧默认展开关键改动: Key changes are expanded by default on the right
messages.本页只读：不再提供手工派发入口。「继续推进」即开始评审——自动起 1~3 位只读: Read-only page: manual dispatch is no longer offered. "Continue" starts the review—automatically launching 1~3 read-only reviewer sessions,
messages.他们自己读目标/验收/scope/改动/自测结果/开发报告，各自给结论。: They read the goal/acceptance/scope/changes/self-test results/dev report themselves and each gives a verdict.
messages.全部通过才允许进入测试验证；不通过退回开发并附纠偏意见；审核员异常或未返回时标记: Test verification is allowed only when all pass; a failure sends it back to development with corrective feedback; reviewers that error out or never respond are marked as pending and never treated as passed.
messages.开发阶段已完成：点顶栏「继续推进」即自动开始本轮评审: Development is complete: click "Continue" in the top bar to start this round of review
messages.评审已结束：可以按结论继续推进流程: Review has ended: you can continue the flow according to the verdict
messages.开发会话还在改代码：等它停下来再继续推进，否则审的是半成品。: The dev session is still editing code: wait for it to stop before continuing, otherwise you'd be reviewing half-finished work.
messages.流程已回到「开发中」：按下面的意见改完，再点「继续推进」重试评审（历史轮次会留在: The flow is back to "Developing": apply the feedback below, then click "Continue" to retry the review (past rounds stay in the ledger).
messages.开发阶段完成、本机自测通过后，点顶栏「继续推进」即自动开始评审（审核员按默认配置: After development is complete and local self-tests pass, click "Continue" in the top bar to start the review automatically (reviewers are created with the default config). Reviewers are read-only and won't change code; their verdicts are written to the ledger and dev report.
messages.分析流程只读：跑通本机自测作为结论证据，通过后流程直接完成（不跑环境测试、不提交: Analysis flows are read-only: local self-tests serve as evidence for the verdict, and the flow completes once they pass (no env tests, no commit)
messages.分析流程只读：结论产出即结束，不建 worktree、不产生提交: Analysis flows are read-only: they end once the verdict is produced, with no worktree and no commits
messages.测试通过后代码/诉求又有变化：旧结果已过期，重跑后才会进入评审: Code/requirements changed after the tests passed: old results are stale, and review starts only after a re-run
messages.跑通后进入「独立评审」；评审通过才允许跑环境测试: Passing moves it to "Independent review"; env tests are allowed only after the review passes
messages.评审未通过：流程已退回开发，按纠偏意见改完再点它重试评审: Review failed: the flow is back in development; apply the corrective feedback, then click to retry the review
messages.评审异常待处理：有审核员未返回结论，点它重试派发（不重复已返回的结论）: Review error pending: a reviewer hasn't returned a verdict; click to retry dispatch (verdicts already returned are not repeated)
messages.本机自测已通过：点它即自动开始评审（审核员按默认配置产生），评审通过后才能跑环境: Local self-tests passed: click to start the review automatically (reviewers use the default config); env tests are available only after the review passes
messages.评审进行中：等审核员返回结论，不要跳过评审直接跑环境测试: Review in progress: wait for reviewers to respond; don't skip the review and run env tests directly
messages.环境验证通过后阶段会进入「待提交」: After env verification passes, the stage moves to "Ready to commit"
messages.环境验证通过后，这个流程自动完成（非 git 仓库没有提交环节）: After env verification passes, this flow completes automatically (non-git repos have no commit step)
messages.测试都过了：选分支、提交并推送: All tests passed: pick a branch, commit, and push
messages.非 git 仓库：测试通过即完成，无需提交/推送: Non-git repo: passing tests completes the flow; no commit/push needed
messages.分析流程用本机自测作为只读证据；通过即结束，不修改代码: Analysis flows use local self-tests as read-only evidence; they end on pass without modifying code
messages.先在本机跑通，再进独立评审: Pass locally first, then move to independent review
messages.本机自测 + 独立评审通过后才可执行: Available only after local self-tests + independent review pass
messages.只提交你勾选的文件，不会 git add -A: Only the files you check are committed; no git add -A
messages.新建分支后推送: Create a new branch and push
git push runs immediately after the commit (new branches get an upstream automatically); the .dev-hub ledger is committed along with the code.
messages.这个代码库不是 git 仓库：没有提交与推送环节。本机自测 + 环境测试都通过后: This repo isn't a git repository: there's no commit or push step. The flow completes automatically once both local self-tests and env tests pass.
messages.默认沿用当前会话（上下文不丢）。只有当前会话不可用、或确实想从零开始时，才需要新: By default the current session is reused (context is kept). Create a new one only if the current session is unavailable or you really want to start from scratch.
messages.「继续推进」只发一句短消息，不重发 Context Pack；只有计划/约束大改: "Continue" sends only a short message and does not resend the Context Pack; resend the latest pack only after major changes to the plan/constraints.
messages.工作站按目标概括；也可以自己改: The workstation summarizes from the goal; you can also edit it yourself
messages.当前标题像原始输入/代码片段：点右边按目标自动概括一个。: The current title looks like raw input/a code snippet: click the button on the right to auto-summarize one from the goal.
messages.只删除这条流程的台账（目标/计划/验收/历史/会话绑定）；**不会**回滚已改代: This only deletes this flow's ledger (goal/plan/acceptance/history/session binding); it does **not** roll back changed code and does **not** delete the DSH dev session.
messages.目标、改动范围、测试结果与提交记录都已归档；需要回看时打开开发报告或变更文件。: The goal, change scope, test results, and commit records are archived; open the dev report or changed files to review them.
messages.但还没绑定开发会话: But no dev session is bound yet
messages.还没有可用的开发会话：请先开启开发会话: No dev session available yet: start a dev session first
messages.已发到开发会话：它会按当前状态推进/给建议，进度显示在下方「会话内容」。: Sent to the dev session: it will advance or advise based on the current state; progress is shown under "Session content" below.
messages.已把答案发回开发会话，它会继续推进。: The answer was sent back to the dev session, which will continue.
messages.答案已提交，但会话当前没在等待（可能已超时）；下方会显示剩余待答问题。: The answer was submitted, but the session isn't waiting right now (it may have timed out); remaining questions are shown below.
messages.已提交，但会话可能已不再等待（已超时）。: Submitted, but the session may no longer be waiting (timed out).
messages.会话在等待授权 / 审批: Session is waiting for authorization / approval
messages.授权/登录类请求只能在会话里确认（DSH 没给插件放行的接口）；点「去会话处理」: Authorization/login requests can only be confirmed in the session (DSH provides no API for plugins to approve them); click "Handle in session" to jump straight to that step.
messages.会话正在前台等你选择: The session is waiting for your choice in the foreground
messages.开发会话在等你回答: The dev session is waiting for your answer
messages.不答就会一直等；也可以「跳过」让它按默认推进: It waits indefinitely without an answer; you can also "Skip" to let it proceed with defaults
messages.这个选择正在会话前台等待，只能在开发会话里点选；工作站不能代答，下面的选项仅用于: This choice is waiting in the session's foreground and can only be selected in the dev session; the workstation can't answer for you, and the options below are for reference only.
messages.也可以直接写你的答案（可留空）: You can also write your answer directly (optional)
messages.按当前状态给你建议；也可以直接说你想推进什么: Get suggestions based on the current state; or just say what you want to advance
messages.开发任务完成不等于流程完成：还要过测试与提交: Finishing the dev task doesn't finish the flow: tests and commit still remain
messages.开发、验证与提交都已完成: Development, verification, and commit are all complete
messages.只断开追踪，不删流程、不动历史: Only disconnects tracking; doesn't delete the flow or touch history
messages.开发会话本轮失败: The dev session failed this round
messages.只代表最近一轮；新一轮开始后会自动清掉: Reflects only the latest round; it clears automatically when a new round starts
messages.流程已完成；无需再绑定开发会话，需要回看时展开上方「开发会话动态」。: The flow is complete; no dev session needs to be bound. Expand "Dev session activity" above to review it.
messages.台账有进展，但没有绑定开发会话: The ledger has progress, but no dev session is bound
messages.当前阶段/测试记录来自 Agent 直接写入台账（没有走工作站绑定），所以右上角: The current stage/test records were written to the ledger directly by the agent (bypassing the workstation binding), so the top right still shows "Start dev session".
messages.点「开启开发会话」会新开一个会话并绑定，之前的台账与历史都不会丢。: Clicking "Start dev session" opens and binds a new session; the existing ledger and history are preserved.
messages.尚未绑定开发会话：点右上角「开启开发会话」，成功后会自动绑定；绑定后这里能看到轮: No dev session bound yet: click "Start dev session" in the top right and it binds automatically on success; once bound, you'll see rounds and recent activity here and can jump back to the session in one click.
messages.点击切换流程类型（bug 先复现/定位；feature 先对齐范围；analys: Click to switch the flow type (bug reproduces/locates first; feature aligns scope first; analysis is read-only and never reaches commit)
messages.bug 模板会要求先复现与定位根因。: The bug template requires reproducing and locating the root cause first.
messages.分析流程只读：不建 worktree、不产生提交，只产出结论与补丁建议。: Analysis flows are read-only: no worktree, no commits—only a verdict and patch suggestions.
messages.feature 先对齐范围与验收，再改代码。: For features, align scope and acceptance before changing code.
messages.开发会话正在工作：等当前这步结束再继续推进: The dev session is working: wait for the current step to finish before continuing
messages.开发前拉取最新代码：git fetch + merge --ff-only（不自: Pull the latest code before development: git fetch + merge --ff-only (no automatic rebase/reset)
messages.低频：只预览 Context Pack，不发给开发会话: Rarely used: only previews the Context Pack without sending it to the dev session
messages.分析流程只读：只读排查 → 结论；不跑环境测试、不进入提交: Analysis flows are read-only: read-only investigation → verdict; no env tests, no commit
messages.阶段随工作自动推进：本机自测通过后点「继续推进」即开始独立评审；评审通过 → 测: Stages advance automatically with the work: after local self-tests pass, click "Continue" to start independent review; review passes → test verification; env verification passes → ready to commit; committed → done
messages.已回到开发中：测试通过后代码/诉求又有变化: Back to developing: code/requirements changed after the tests passed
messages.旧测试结论已过期，请在当前改动上重跑本机自测。: The old test results are stale; re-run local self-tests on the current changes.
messages.开发中：开发会话正在工作，完成后到「测试与提交」跑本机自测: Developing: the dev session is working; when it finishes, run local self-tests under "Tests & Commit"
messages.评审异常待处理：有审核员没有返回结论，流程不会进入测试验证；点「继续推进」重试派: Review error pending: a reviewer hasn't returned a verdict, so the flow won't move to test verification; click "Continue" to retry dispatch.
messages.独立评审进行中：等审核员返回结论，不要跳过评审直接跑环境测试。: Independent review in progress: wait for reviewers to respond; don't skip the review and run env tests directly.
messages.继续推进即开始评审：自动派 1~3 位审核员复核改动与证据，全部通过后才进入测试: Continue to start review: 1~3 reviewers are dispatched to check the changes and evidence, and test verification starts only after all pass.
messages.测试验证完成：本机与环境都通过，接下来去「测试与提交」提交并推送。: Test verification complete: both local and env tests passed; next, go to "Tests & Commit" to commit and push.
messages.测试验证还没完成：本机自测已通过，还需要跑「环境测试」才会进入「待提交」。: Test verification isn't complete: local self-tests passed, but "Env test" must still run before it moves to "Ready to commit".
messages.测试验证还没完成：先在「测试与提交」里跑本机自测。: Test verification isn't complete: run local self-tests under "Tests & Commit" first.
messages.默认只读；点「编辑」才展开输入框: Read-only by default; click "Edit" to show the input box
messages.复制失败，请手动选择文本: Copy failed, please select the text manually
messages.还没有成员标识，请先完成初始化: No member ID yet; please complete initialization first
messages.该流程还没有绑定开发会话: This flow is not bound to a development session yet
messages.当前环境没有可用的会话工作区，无法跳转开发会话: No session workspace is available in the current environment; cannot open the development session
messages.解绑当前开发会话？流程内容与历史不受影响，只是不再追踪该会话。: Unbind the current development session? Flow content and history are unaffected; the session will simply no longer be tracked.
messages.已开启新会话并把上下文放进输入框（当前版本不支持自动发送），确认后按发送即可开始: A new session has been opened with the context in the input box (this version does not support auto-send); confirm and press Send to start.
messages.虚拟库至少需要两个不同的代码库：勾选已登记的库，或在下面每行填一个路径: A virtual library needs at least two different repositories: check registered repositories, or enter one path per line below
messages.低频；需要探测环境或修改测试命令时展开: Low frequency; expand when you need to probe the environment or change test commands
messages.在工作站开启开发会话: Start a development session on the workstation
messages.调整成员库或改名。成员库平权：任意成员（包括第一个）都可以移除或替换；新增成员从: Adjust member repositories or rename. All member repositories are equal: any member (including the first) can be removed or replaced; newly added members count changes from the current HEAD.
messages.把前后端等多个代码库当成一个开发目标：扫描、计划、变更会一起看；台账/规范/上下: Treat multiple repositories (e.g. frontend and backend) as one development target: scans, plans, and changes are viewed together; the ledger/conventions/context/evidence are all written to a separate local directory, not to any member repository.
messages.成员库（勾选调整；成员库平权）: Member repositories (check to adjust; all members are equal)
messages.已登记的代码库（勾选加入，仅列出路径存在的）: Registered repositories (check to add; only those whose paths exist are listed)
messages.还没有已登记的代码库；直接在下面填路径（每行一个，都是平权成员库）。: No registered repositories yet; just enter paths below (one per line, all equal member repositories).
messages.新增成员库路径（每行一个，可留空）: New member repository paths (one per line, may be left blank)
messages.其它代码库路径（每行一个，可只填这里）: Other repository paths (one per line; you can fill in only these)
messages.代码库路径，每行一个，例如：\n/Users/you/backend\n/Use:
Repository paths, one per line, e.g.:
/Users/you/backend
/Users/you/frontend
messages.取消勾选 = 移除成员（任意成员都可移除）: Unchecking = remove member (any member can be removed)
messages.至少 2 个；成员库平权: At least 2; all member repositories are equal
messages.当前 DSH 不支持目录选择，请手动输入路径: This DSH does not support directory selection; please enter the path manually

messages.报告还没有分节内容。: The report has no section content yet.
messages.没有拿到报告内容，可以点「刷新」重试。: No report content received; click "Refresh" to try again.
messages.报告没有给出结论原因。: The report gave no reason for its conclusion.
messages.只读排查 · 含证据与补丁建议: Read-only investigation · includes evidence and patch suggestions
messages.后台台账实时回写: Ledger written back in real time in the background
messages.报告由 .dev-hub 台账与本机 git 事实生成，不调用模型、不发网络请求: The report is generated from the .dev-hub ledger and local git facts; it does not call a model or make network requests. Without a baseline, or outside a git repository, it explicitly marks "evidence incomplete" and never fabricates a diff.
messages.流程还没完成，报告会随台账更新。现在看到的是阶段性结果，不代表已通过验收。: The flow is not finished yet; the report updates with the ledger. What you see now is an interim result and does not mean acceptance has passed.
messages.流程被标记为阻塞；报告只反映当前事实，解除阻塞后再刷新。: The flow is marked blocked; the report reflects current facts only. Refresh after the block is cleared.
messages.这个会话还没有关联开发流程: This session is not linked to a development flow yet
messages.还没有进行中的开发流程: No development flows in progress yet
messages.提示：流程阶段随工作自动推进；会话状态每 5 秒刷新一次。: Tip: flow stages advance automatically as you work; session status refreshes every 5 seconds.
messages.没有可展示的消息（会话可能尚未开始或已被清理）: No messages to show (the session may not have started or may have been cleaned up)
messages.虚拟库本机独立目录（不是任何成员库）: Virtual library local standalone directory (not any member repository)
messages.已有规范文件不会被自动改写；补装只追加该技能包的约束，之后可随时卸载。: Existing conventions files are not overwritten automatically; installing another pack only appends that pack's constraints and can be uninstalled at any time.
messages.仓库还没有生成规范文件: No conventions file has been generated for this repository yet
messages.卸载只移除该技能带来的约束，不改自定义项: Uninstalling removes only the constraints from that skill and leaves custom entries untouched
messages.按仓库语言给出可用技能包；前端包按 package.json 框架依赖自动判定，: Available skill packs are listed by repository language; the frontend pack is determined automatically from package.json framework dependencies, and installed ones are listed too for comparison
messages.前端仓库默认装: Installed by default for frontend repositories
messages.当前语言没有可用的技能包。: No skill packs are available for the current language.
messages.内置项随技能包安装/卸载；自定义项可编辑/删除: Built-in entries follow skill pack install/uninstall; custom entries can be edited/deleted
messages.还没有约束；安装技能包或新增自定义约束。: No constraints yet; install a skill pack or add a custom constraint.
messages.编辑时不可改 id: The id cannot be changed while editing
messages.自定义约束的唯一标识: Unique identifier for the custom constraint
messages.例如：团队评审必须双人: e.g. team reviews must have two reviewers
messages.写清「什么情况算违反、应该怎么做」: State clearly "what counts as a violation and what should be done"
messages.请先到「流程」页完成代码库初始化，再回来管理技能与约束。: Please finish repository initialization on the "Flows" page first, then come back to manage skills and constraints.
messages.例如：把关卡状态回传从同步改成异步，解决连接池被远端 IO 占满的问题……: e.g. Change gate status reporting from synchronous to asynchronous to fix the connection pool being exhausted by remote IO……
messages.说清「要解决什么问题、谁受影响、成功标准」即可，名称稍后可以改。: Just state "what problem to solve, who is affected, and the success criteria"; the name can be changed later.
messages.流程 id（台账文件名，创建后不再改）: Flow id (ledger file name; cannot be changed after creation)
messages.目标（可留空：工作站会按需求规范化生成）: Goal (may be left blank: the workstation will generate a normalized one from the requirement)
messages.留空 = 由工作站把上面的需求整理成「做什么 + 为什么」；也可以自己写一句目标: Leave blank = the workstation turns the requirement above into "what + why"; you can also write a one-line goal yourself
messages.客户原话会单独保存为「原始需求」，不会直接当成目标。: The customer's original words are saved separately as the "original requirement" and are not used directly as the goal.
messages.暂无模块建议，请手动填写。: No module suggestions yet; please fill them in manually.
messages.代码目录与模块（一行一个；裸路径 = 目录，module:xxx = 模块名）: Code directories and modules (one per line; bare path = directory, module:xxx = module name)
messages.与开发中的流程存在范围重叠: Scope overlaps with flows in development
messages.建议改为串行：等上述流程完成，或先把范围挪开再并行。: Consider switching to serial: wait for the flows above to finish, or move the scope before running in parallel.
messages.与当前开发中的流程没有范围重叠，可以并行。: No scope overlap with flows currently in development; can run in parallel.
messages.这一步会生成仓库级规范文件（.dev-hub/conventions.json）: This step generates a repository-level conventions file (.dev-hub/conventions.json) that every subsequent flow reuses.
messages.暂不初始化，返回修改范围: Skip initialization and return to edit the scope
messages.先完成初始化，或点「暂不初始化」返回上一步。: Finish initialization first, or click "Skip initialization" to return to the previous step.
messages.提示：create 成功后会自动打开该流程详情；Host 会返回 paralle: Tip: after a successful create, that flow's details open automatically; the Host returns parallel for parallel-conflict hints.
messages.下面是可能要改的文件与命中行，确认后我再建流程并开启开发会话。: Below are the files that may need changes and the matching lines. Once you confirm, I'll create the flow and start a development session.
messages.再多写一点：至少一句话说明要做什么: Add a bit more: describe what to do in at least one sentence
messages.工程量：工作站暂未给出自评: Effort: the workstation hasn't given a self-assessment yet
messages.当前版本缺少计划接口，请升级工作站插件后再试: This version has no planning API; please upgrade the workstation plugin and try again
messages.至少要保留一个目录或模块，否则并行冲突没法判定: Keep at least one directory or module, otherwise parallel conflicts can't be determined
messages.工作站没有返回开发计划: The workstation didn't return a development plan
messages.工作站返回的计划没有步骤，先别开工；补充描述或调整范围后重试: The plan returned by the workstation has no steps, so don't start yet; add more detail or adjust the scope, then retry
messages.Host 没有返回流程 id，创建可能没成功: The host didn't return a flow id; creation may not have succeeded
messages.；注意：与进行中的流程 scope 有重叠，建议串行。: ; note: the scope overlaps with an in-progress flow, serial execution is recommended.
messages.开工前检查：当前代码已是最新。: Pre-start check: the code is already up to date.
messages.已记录 baseline，并按规范 + 目标文件生成了 Context Pack: Baseline recorded, and the Context Pack was generated from the conventions plus the target files.
messages.当前扫描/澄清还在处理，结束后会自动继续…: The current scan/clarification is still running; it will continue automatically when it finishes…
messages.上一轮请求超过 2 分钟没有收尾，已停止等待；如果结果没出来，请重新发一句。: The previous request didn't wrap up within 2 minutes, so I stopped waiting; if no result appeared, please send another message.
messages.上次的澄清可能已经完成；如需继续，点最新一轮的「继续补充（再问一轮）」。: The last clarification may already be done; to continue, click “Continue adding (ask another round)” in the latest round.
messages.上次的扫描/澄清已中断超过 15 分钟，直接重新发一句即可。: The last scan/clarification was interrupted more than 15 minutes ago; just send another message.
messages.刚才的扫描被切走了，已自动重新扫描…: The previous scan was switched away from, so it's rescanning automatically…
messages.刚才的澄清被切走了，已自动接着问…: The previous clarification was switched away from, so it's continuing to ask automatically…
messages.刚才生成计划时你切走了：确认范围后点「继续，生成计划」重试。: You switched away while the plan was being generated: confirm the scope, then click “Continue, generate plan” to retry.
messages.一条需求最多带 8 个附件: One request can carry at most 8 attachments
messages.上一次扫描还没结束：等它回来再发，或点「新对话」另开一段。: The previous scan hasn't finished: wait for it to come back, or click “New conversation” to start a separate one.
messages.扫描仓库：让 dsh 找可能要改的文件: Scan repository: let dsh find the files that may need changes
messages.附件已就绪：再补一句要做什么（Enter 发送）: Attachments ready: add one sentence about what to do (press Enter to send)

messages.正在按最新讨论重新扫描…: Rescanning based on the latest discussion…
messages.（可能是描述还不够具体）: (the description may not be specific enough)

messages.（这轮没有问题可答）: (there are no questions to answer in this round)
messages.这次对话的原始描述丢了（可能刷新过页面）。请在下面重新说一句「要做什么」，我接着: The original description for this conversation is gone (the page may have been refreshed). Please restate “what to do” below and I'll keep asking.
messages.提醒：这次没拿到工作站总结后的需求（目标/根因还是客户原话，已标记待规范化）。: Heads-up: this time the workstation's summarized requirement wasn't available (the goal/root cause is still the customer's own wording, marked as pending normalization).
messages.到「流程」详情页点「让工作站规范化」再开工，效果更稳。: Go to the Flows details page and click “Let the workstation normalize” before starting; the result is more reliable.
messages.已把这个会话关联到本流程。: This session has been linked to this flow.
messages.已回到范围确认：改完文件/范围或追问答案后，重新点「继续，生成计划」。: Back to scope confirmation: after changing files/scope or answering follow-up questions, click “Continue, generate plan” again.
messages.工作站正在结合仓库证据整理澄清问题…: The workstation is preparing clarification questions from repository evidence…
messages.工作站正在调用 dsh 扫仓库（通常 30~90 秒，会真的读代码）…: The workstation is calling dsh to scan the repository (usually 30–90 seconds; it really reads the code)…
